source: LiTS part 2 volumes (andrewmvd/liver-tumor-segmentation-part-2) + masks from part 1
rule: candidates = LiTS patients 51-130 (never used to train anything: CT-Mamba/CTformer/ CoreDiff saw only Mayo, nnU-Net and the refiner/control only the part-1 train split) with at least one tumour and at most --max-slices liver slices (disk and time). Order: most tumours under 10 mm first, then most tumours, then patient number. Add patients in that order until the 34 tumours of the existing 10 test patients plus the new ones reach --target (100). The extended test set = existing 10 locked patients + these.
